patch_description: A different construction pipeline replacing the current one. Instead of only global frequency ranking plus one recursive (k*(k-1))-repetition tree, this version builds three structurally distinct candidate per-row orderings: (1) a global frequency-ranked order, (2) a conditional partition tree whose per-node column gain is the true trie-edge saving Σ len·(count−1) (the actual number of shared characters a split saves, not squared counts), and (3) a flat two-level clustering variant — rows are split once on their highest-entropy column into value groups, and each group receives its own independently frequency-ranked global column order (no recursion). All candidates are scored with the exact ideal character-trie objective (sum of adjacent LCPs over sorted serialized rows, computed with C-speed binary-search prefix comparisons), and the best is returned. The diversity of statistics (squared repetition vs edge savings vs entropy-flat-clustering) targets the low-scoring dataset where the previous single tree statistic failed, while the bounded candidate count keeps runtime comparable or better.
